# 🧠 ai-quality

Testing LLM features, guardrails, groundedness and agent skills.

Install: `ai-quality@jaktestowac`. See the [quick start](https://github.com/jaktestowac/awesome-agents-for-quality#-quick-start) for each tool.

📘 **Guide:** [AI product QA](guides/ai-product-qa.md) shows how the pieces work together.

## Commands

Run these yourself: `/name` in Claude Code and GitHub Copilot, `$name` in Codex. The agent never starts them on its own.

- [`design-llm-eval-suite`](skills/design-llm-eval-suite/SKILL.md): Design an LLM eval suite
- [`test-llm-guardrails`](skills/test-llm-guardrails/SKILL.md): Test LLM guardrails and injection resistance

## Agents

| Agent | Claude Code | GitHub Copilot | Codex |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| LLM Feature Test Engineer - evals, guardrails, red team | [`llm-feature-test-engineer`](agents/llm-feature-test-engineer.md) | [`llm-feature-test-engineer`](.github/agents/llm-feature-test-engineer.agent.md) | [`llm_feature_test_engineer`](codex/agents/llm-feature-test-engineer.toml) |

Claude Code and GitHub Copilot load these agents with the plugin.
Codex does not load agents from plugins: copy the files from [`codex/agents/`](codex/agents/) into your project's `.codex/agents/` or into `~/.codex/agents/`.
